title: Age-dependent random connection models with arc reciprocity: clustering and connectivity
summary: We introduce a model for directed spatial networks. Starting from an age-based preferential attachment model in which all arcs point from younger to older vertices, we add \emph{reciprocal} connections whose probabilities depend on the age difference between their end-vertices. This yields a directed graph with reciprocal correlations, a power-law indegree distribution, and a tunable outdegree distribution. We consider two versions of the model: an infinite version embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$, which can be constructed as a weight-dependent random connection model with a non-symmetric kernel,…
